content: पातञ्जल {%a.%} (-ली|{%f.%}) Composed by Patañjali; पातञ्जले महाभाष्ये कृतभूरिपरिश्रमः <ls>Pari. Śekh.</ls> .{@-लम्@} The Yoga system of philosophy taught by Patañjali. (It is generally believed that Patañjali, the author of the Mahābhāṣya, is the same as the author of the Yoga system; but it is a dubious point.)
